probes.title: Leaky strategy (look-ahead inside a signal)
probes.truth: A user-defined signal reading future bars.
probes.detail: Rule strategies are stateless over a fixed trailing window of closes/highs/lows (packages/alpha-strategies/src/alpha_strategies/rules.py); registered strategies read through as_of; bias guards cover each unit. Agent-introduced look-ahead is tested in Layer B (ADV01).

probes.title: ML label leak (feature equals shifted target)
probes.truth: A feature that is the future label.
probes.detail: The ML feature recipe is fixed (alpha158) with available_at stamping and per-fold purge/embargo, and results return through a hash-locked worker exchange. There is also no target-permutation leakage test, so a leak introduced upstream of the recipe would not be detected — recorded as a gap, not a pass.
